description: This file defines the LevelDBIterator class, which implements a key-value store iterator for LevelDB within Apache Spark's kvstore module. It manages iteration over database entries with support for ascending/descending order, skipping, and resource cleanup.

classes.name: ResourceCleaner
classes.description: Inner class responsible for cleaning up LevelDB iterator resources asynchronously.

methods.name: hasNext
methods.description: Checks if there is a next element in the iteration.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next element in the iteration, deserialized into type T.

methods.name: next(int max)
methods.description: Returns a list of up to max elements from the iterator.

methods.name: skip
methods.description: Skips n elements in the iterator.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the iterator and releases resources.

methods.name: loadNext
methods.description: Loads the next valid entry from the database.
